description: This file contains decorator classes and utility functions for testing in the oeqa framework, specifically for skipping tests based on system features, machine types, and data store variables.

classes.name: skipIfDataVar
classes.description: Decorator class to skip tests based on a data store variable's value.

classes.name: skipIfNotDataVar
classes.description: Decorator class to skip tests if a data store variable's value does not match.

classes.name: skipIfInDataVar
classes.description: Decorator class to skip tests if a data store variable contains a specific value.

classes.name: skipIfNotInDataVar
classes.description: Decorator class to skip tests if a data store variable does not contain a specific value.

classes.name: OETestDataDepends
classes.description: Decorator class to declare dependencies on data store variables.

classes.name: skipIfNotFeature
classes.description: Decorator class to skip tests if a feature is not present in DISTRO_FEATURES or IMAGE_FEATURES.

classes.name: skipIfFeature
classes.description: Decorator class to skip tests if a feature is present in DISTRO_FEATURES or IMAGE_FEATURES.

classes.name: skipIfNotMachine
classes.description: Decorator class to skip tests if the MACHINE does not match a specified value.

classes.name: skipIfMachine
classes.description: Decorator class to skip tests if the MACHINE matches a specified value.

classes.name: skipIfNotQemu
classes.description: Decorator class to skip tests if MACHINE is not qemu*.

classes.name: skipIfQemu
classes.description: Decorator class to skip tests if MACHINE is qemu*.

methods.name: has_feature
methods.description: Checks if a feature is present in DISTRO_FEATURES or IMAGE_FEATURES.

methods.name: has_machine
methods.description: Checks if a specific MACHINE matches the data store.
